data.name: AI — Rumors & Insights
data.description: Discuss the state of AI from industry insiders and anons 🕵️‍♂️

rules.name: Make relevant and useful posts 🙂
rules.description: Post useful, relevant, informative AI insights

rules.name: Make sure content is High Quality 📈
Quote Posts must add useful info ⚠️
rules.description: Do not self-quote. Quote posts must add useful info.

rules.name: Do not post Spam 🗑️
rules.description: No spam, promo / ads, off-topic, hashtags

rules.name: Check earlier posts 💬
rules.description: Don't post about same thing if others posts first.

rules.name: Source the insights 🔎
rules.description: Provide source directly in the main post!

rules.name: Verify your information 🕵‍♂
rules.description: Do not vague post and verify your information before you post!

rules.name: Don't share access methods 🤫
rules.description: Do not share working methods to access info on unreleased products / services in the scope of AI.
